columns.name: name
columns.description: Name of the customer. Concatenate the first name and last name with a space separating them.

columns.name: address
columns.description: Address of the customer. Concatenate the street address, city and state with a space separating them.

columns.name: num_reviews
columns.description: Number of reviews the customer has written, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: purchased_beer_by_ASB
columns.description: set to 1 if the customer has purchased at least one root beer produced by AJ Stephans Beverages, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: date_first_bought
columns.description: Date the customer first bought a root beer.

columns.name: num_non_sweetened
columns.description: Number of non-sweetened root beers the customer has purchased, replace NULL values with 0. Non-sweetened root beers are defined as root beers that do not contain artificial sweetener and honey.

columns.name: bought_beers_contain_artificial_sweetener
columns.description: set to 1 if the customer has purchased at least one root beer that contains artificial sweetener, otherwise, set to 0

models.name: brands
models.description: Each record represents a brand of root beer.

columns.name: address
columns.description: Address of the brand. Concatenate the city, state, and country with a space separating them.

columns.name: num_5_stars
columns.description: Number of 5-star ratings the brand has received, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: not_advertise_on_Facebook_and_Twitter
columns.description: set to 1 if the brand does not advertise on Facebook and Twitter, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: unit_profit
columns.description: the unit profit of the brand available to wholesalers

columns.name: avg_rating_star
columns.description: Average rating star of the brand.

columns.name: latitude_consumed_most
columns.description: Latitude where the brand is consumed the most with ties broken by the descending order of the latitude
